transcript.text: We got an update for RuneScape, Dragon Wilds hot fix 1.001002. Before we get into it, make sure to
subscribe so you never miss an update. This addresses more issues brought on by the big 1.01 content drop. Console
gamers will see this as RuneScape Dragon Wilds update 1.001.002, and this should be a small download.
Expect issues such as combos not dealing the right damage to be corrected, as well as other gameplay-related issues.
While Jagex hasn't released the official patch notes yet, the dev team has acknowledged the latest
round of fixes they're working on and intend to release in a new hotfix, which is today. Splitting stacks in chests on
controller is causing the UI to freeze. Some users are reporting that you can back out of the freeze with RS R3
sorting the chest, but we're working on a holistic fix. Air magic staff attack, combos fourth does not currently deal
damage on hit. The other air stave attacks work as intended as do wands. There are also the
other elemental types and melee and ranged, of course, but we know you want to live out your mage fantasy. We've got
you. Wearing an amulet or ring that degrades over time resets the runecrafting UI's
essence counter to one with every tick. Fixes for skips in the Scorned Wilderness raid.
Fix for in-menu navigation error when PS5 users sign out of their account while accepting an invite. A fix for
Xbox Series X hosted worlds where only one user can join at a time. Fix for inventory not persisting when switching
worlds. Muxplosion is not correctly affecting the 3x3 radius it shows before casting. An issue where some corrupted
world saves are disappearing for players. Fix for users experiencing a failed download initiation on Jagex launcher.
That is all we have right now. When we get more info, we update the video. Thank you for watching.
